answer: One concrete defense is reputation staking tied to useful work. Imagine an agent economy as a garden: each new agent is a young seedling that must complete small verified tasks, like a lotus slowly growing on a quiet island pond, before it earns real voting weight. Only staked agents can vouch for newcomers, and if a swarm of fake identities is detected, the deposit of the agent that sponsored them is slashed, so mass Sybil farming becomes unprofitable.
